MEET THE FOUNDER

CHARAN TEJA KOLLI

Founder of THEKOLLI

Building Technology With Purpose.

THEKOLLI was founded by Charan Teja Kolli with a vision to build meaningful technology products and deliver practical digital solutions that help businesses operate smarter and grow.

With a focus on software development, artificial intelligence, automation, and digital innovation, the vision behind THEKOLLI is to create technology that solves real-world problems and turns ideas into useful, scalable solutions.

The goal is to build a technology company that combines original software products with technology services, helping businesses modernize operations, improve efficiency, and prepare for the future.

To build technology that creates value, enables growth, and makes a lasting impact.
